verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Surely, We sent it down on the Night of Destiny.
And what should make thee know what the Night of Destiny is?

verses.ar: لَیۡلَۃُ الۡقَدۡرِ ۬ۙ خَیۡرٌ مِّنۡ اَلۡفِ شَہۡرٍ ؕ﴿ؔ۴﴾
verses.en: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.

verses.ar: تَنَزَّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃُ وَالرُّوۡحُ فِیۡہَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّہِمۡ ۚ مِنۡ کُلِّ اَمۡرٍ ۙ﴿ۛ۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]Therein descend angels and the Spirit by the command of their Lord — with every matter.
[✲]It is all peace till the rising of the dawn.
